config.cleanertooltips.title: Cleaner Tooltips Config
config.cleanertooltips.option.iconsEnabl: Whether attributes should be displayed as icons.
config.cleanertooltips.option.comparison: Show a comparison of attributes between the hovered over and equipped item.
Whether an animated arrow should additionally indicate the comparison.
config.cleanertooltips.option.onlyCompar: Only compare attributes both items have.
config.cleanertooltips.option.hintEnable:
If an item has attributes that cannot be displayed, display a hint. "[+]"
Blacklisting attributes or modifiers also disables their hints.
config.cleanertooltips.option.customOrde: Whether to use a custom priority-based ordering, otherwise use the default insertion order.
config.cleanertooltips.option.attributeI:
A list of attributes that are excluded from being rendered.
Contains 'entity_interaction_range' by default if 'Better Combat' is installed.
config.cleanertooltips.option.modifierId:
A list of modifier ids that are excluded from being rendered. Use '#' to match any number.
Use '/get_modifier_ids' to get the modifier ids of a held item.
config.cleanertooltips.option.attributeG: The distance between the individual attributes.
config.cleanertooltips.option.innerGap.t: The distance between the number and the icon.
config.cleanertooltips.option.groupDispl:
Change how several equipment slot groups are displayed.
ROWS: each group is in a different row.
INLINE: all groups are in the same row.
Note: a slot group is the "When in Main Hand:" (or similar) text.
config.cleanertooltips.option.sharpnessF: Whether sharpness should change the attack damage. This fixes MC-271840.
config.cleanertooltips.option.miningSpee:
Whether to display the mining speed of tools, either as an icon or as text.
Note: Hides the mining efficiency attribute text.
config.cleanertooltips.option.durability: Whether the durability of items should be displayed.
Whether to include the maximum durability of an item.
config.cleanertooltips.option.hideWhenRe: Only display the durability when the item is damaged.
config.cleanertooltips.option.durability: Whether the color of the durability should change based on the remaining durability.
Change the style of the durability.

Change the position of the durability.
INLINE: same row as the attributes.
BELOW: directly under the attributes.
BOTTOM: at the bottom of the tooltip.

Change how the durability color should change.
DEFAULT: color changes when durability drops below a color stop.
LINEAR: color changes linearly based on the color stops.
NATIVE: same color as the durability bar.
